title: This Turtle Fishes With a Fake Worm Inside Its Mouth

scenes.text: This turtle fishes with a fake worm in its mouth.
The alligator snapping turtle can weigh over 150 pounds.
It lies motionless on the riverbed, mouth wide open.
Inside, a red, wriggling lure looks like a juicy worm.
A curious fish swims in for a snack.
Snap. The fish was the snack all along.

description:
This turtle fishes with a fake worm in its mouth.
The alligator snapping turtle lies still on the riverbed with its jaws open and wiggles a worm-like lure to draw fish in. Adults typically weigh 155 to 175 pounds.
Would you fall for it? Tell us below.
first_comment: Captive alligator snapping turtles have lived to 70. What other animal uses bait?
